paragraphs.source_en: ‘It don’t matter,’ said Traddles. ‘I began, by means of his assistance, to copy law writings. That put it in my head to enter myself as a law student; and that ran away with all that was left of the fifty pounds. Yawler recommended me to one or two other offices, however—Mr. Waterbrook’s for one—and I got a good many jobs.
